investigation.title: Remote Agent Provisioning: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-21T12:26:31–12:27:05Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable when POST /api/agents was called. Because the failure occurred before any agent was created, zero required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were collected, causing a complete contract violation for the remote-agent-create check.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway backing POST /api/agents (an AWS ELB endpoint in us-east-2) returned HTTP 502 with error code bad_gateway and message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every remote-agent check attempted during this run. The failure is localized to the swarm provisioning gateway dependency, not to the eval runner logic or the production API application layer itself. Because the gateway was unreachable, createAgent() in infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs (line 1885) could not complete, and no evidence was written, causing all four required evidence fields to be missing. The root cause is uncertain between: (a) a transient ELB/network outage in us-east-2, (b) a misconfigured or unhealthy swarm backend target group, or (c) a deployment or configuration change to the swarm service. No historical run data is available to bound the outage window, and no suspect changes are identified in sourceDiscovery.suspectChanges.
